about:
EEEA Inc., based in Simpsonville, South Carolina, was founded in 1974 on a simple principle: put the customer first. The company began with a handshake and the question “How can we help you?” and has grown into an electronics manufacturing partner serving aerospace, defense, medical, industrial, and utility markets.

The company operates a 40,000-square-foot facility where it provides printed circuit board manufacturing (single-layer to multi-layer), surface-mount and through-hole assembly, mixed-technology builds, selective soldering, custom wire harnesses, control panel assemblies, and full electromechanical integration. Services also include quick-turn prototyping, reverse engineering, design engineering using Pads and AutoCAD, and 100% AOI inspection on all SMT boards. The team averages 15 years of industry experience, and there are no minimum order quantities.

EEEA serves aerospace, defense, medical, industrial, automotive, textile, and utility sectors. Examples include precision assemblies built to withstand demanding environments and regulatory standards for aerospace, reliable electronic controls for heavy-duty industrial applications, high-quality assemblies for life-saving medical devices, durable electronics for automotive components, advanced controls for high-performance textile machinery, and specialized electrical testing products such as breaker simulators and grounding testers for power and utility systems.

The company emphasizes a relationship-driven approach, ISO 9001:2015 and IPC-certified processes, dual AOI machines, Red Rabbit test systems, and a workforce with deep tenure as key differentiators. Its founding commitment to customer success continues to guide operations, with leadership including President Brent Buckner and a long-tenured production team.
